_doc: tools/import_hug_guns.gd reads this: every <kind>_<tier>.png here (the gun alone, horizontal, muzzle RIGHT, no hand grips, flat green backdrop) → assets/weapons/<kind>/hug_<tier>.png + assets/weapons/hug.json. length: world px long in the match (57: about 1.5 × Rookie's kneeling body width); per gun (guns.<kind>_<tier>) length, hold [x, y] and muzzle [x, y] (source px) may be set. See the tool's header and assets/README.md.
